_comment: Single source of truth for client -> prebuild-target maps. Consumed by scripts/test-affected.sh (via scripts/lib-test-targets.sh) and test/shared/test-prebuild.ts (targetsForClient, used by the per-client global-setup.ts files). `paths` routes changed files to a client lane; `prebuild` is the target set that lane needs prebuilt. Guarded by scripts/check-test-targets.sh.
